title: lasiorrhiza gossypina
intro: Lasiorrhiza gossypina, commonly known as Gossypinevine, is a type of flowering plant native to Australia and New Guinea. It is a climber that has been traditionally used by indigenous Australians for its medicinal properties. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Lasiorrhiza gossypina include iridoid glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
